source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of optical isomerism (PDF 32-33).

blocks.text: Optical isomers aik doosre ki aisi aaina shakalein hain jo aik doosre par poori nahi baithtin. Optical isomerism aam taur par bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes dikhate hain, maslan 1,2-diaminoethane (NH2CH2CH2NH2) ka nickel(II) complex, [Ni(en)3]2+. Is ki do shakalein aisi aaina shakalein hain jo aik doosre par nahi baithtin; aise jore ko enantiomers kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Dashed aaine ki lakeer ke dono taraf [Ni(en)3]2+ ke do octahedral khaake. Har aik mein Ni ion chhe N atoms se jura aur teen khamdaar jamni kariyan (en) har aik do saath wale N atoms ko jorti hain. Daen shakal baen ki aaina shakal hai.
blocks.caption: [Ni(en)3]2+ ke do optical isomers jo aik doosre par nahi baithte (Figure 18.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har 1,2-diaminoethane (en) ligand do saath wali jagahon se jurta hai, is liye teen en nickel ion ke gird pankhe ke paron ki tarah lipat jate hain. Dono shakalein aik doosre ki aaina shakal hain aur kaise bhi ghumayein aik doosre par poori nahi baithtin: yeh enantiomers hain, aur plane-polarised roshni ko ulti simton mein ghumate hain.

blocks.text: Optical isomers polarised roshni ke plane ko ulti simton mein ghumate hain. Jo isomer use daen taraf ghumaye woh dextrorotatory (+) aur jo baen taraf ghumaye woh laevorotatory (-) hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si shakalein cis-trans isomerism dikhati hain?
Complex ke optical isomerism dikhane ke liye aksar kis qism ka ligand chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Octahedral complex mein bidentate ligand (jaise en).

blocks.prompt: [Ni(en)3]2+ ke liye coordination number aur ligand ki qism batayein.
blocks.explanation: Coordination number 6 (teen en, har aik do bonds); en bidentate hai.

blocks.prompt: [Ni(NH2CH2CH2NH2)3]2+ kaun si isomerism dikhata hai, aur isomers plane-polarised roshni par kya asar karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Optical isomerism; dono enantiomers polarised roshni ke plane ko barabar miqdar mein ulti simton mein ghumate hain, aik (+) daen aur doosra (-) baen.

blocks.prompt: Optical isomers (enantiomers) ki taareef aaina shakal aur superimposability ke hawale se karein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh aik doosre ki aaina shakalein hain jo aik doosre par nahi baithtin.

items: Optical isomers: aaina shakalein jo aik doosre par na baithein (enantiomers).
Bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes, maslan [Ni(en)3]2+.
